mapper.select:
select cca.*, (select wm_concat(fat.file_name) from fnd_atm_attachment fat, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where fat.attachment_id = faam.attachment_id and faam.table_name = 'CON_CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT' and faam.table_pk_value = cca.contract_attachment_id ) file_name from CON_CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT cca where source_Type = 'CON_CONTRACT_LOAN' and contract_Attachment_Category = 'CON_CONTRACT_LOAN'
and cca.CONTRACT_ID =#{contractId}

select sf.file_id as file_id, sf.file_name as file_name, sf.file_size as file_size, sf.description, (select su.description from sys_user su where sf.last_updated_by = su.user_id) as upload_person, sf.last_update_date as upload_date from SYS_ATTACHMENT sa, SYS_FILE sf where sa.ATTACHMENT_ID = sf.ATTACHMENT_ID and sa.SOURCE_KEY=#{contractId} and sa.SOURCE_TYPE in ('CON_CONTRACT_END','PRJ_TRANSFER_GD','PRJ_TRANSFER_PROOF_GD')

select cca.CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT_ID, cca.CONTRACT_ID, cca.CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT_CATEGORY, cca.SOURCE_ID, cca.DOCUMENT_NAME, cca.DESCRIPTION, (select wm_concat(faa.file_name) from FND_ATM_ATTACHMENT faa, FND_ATM_ATTACHMENT_MULTI faam where faa.ATTACHMENT_ID = faam.ATTACHMENT_ID and to_char(cca.contract_attachment_id) = faam.table_pk_value and faam.table_name = 'CON_CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT') file_names, (select wm_concat(faam.attachment_id) from FND_ATM_ATTACHMENT_MULTI faam where to_char(cca.contract_attachment_id) = faam.table_pk_value and faam.table_name = 'CON_CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT') attachment_id from CON_CONTRACT_ATTACHMENT cca where cca.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId}

select m.attachment_id, m.source_type_code, m.source_pk_value, m.content, m.file_type_code, m.mime_type, m.file_name, m.file_size, m.file_path, m.created_by, m.creation_date, m.last_updated_by, m.last_update_date from FND_ATM_ATTACHMENT m where m.ATTACHMENT_ID = #{attachment_id}
